preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 2^16 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= degree_i <= n - 1 and 0 <= s_i < 2**16 for degree_i, s_i in zip(degrees, sums))
preconditions.description: Each degree_i is between 0 and n-1 inclusive, and each s_i is between 0 and 2^16 exclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of edges m is half the sum of all degrees.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n and a != b for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) connects two distinct vertices within the range 0 to n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted([a, b]) in edges or sorted([b, a]) in edges for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) is listed exactly once in any order.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(neighbors) == s_i for i, s_i in enumerate(sums) if (neighbors := [b for a, b in edges if a == i] + [a for a, b in edges if b == i]))
postconditions.description: The XOR sum of the neighbors of each vertex i matches s_i.

postconditions.expression: all(len(neighbors) == degree_i for i, degree_i in enumerate(degrees) if (neighbors := [b for a, b in edges if a == i] + [a for a, b in edges if b == i]))
postconditions.description: The number of neighbors of each vertex i matches degree_i.
